name: jev-pilot
description: TypeSafe's Jev decides how Claude Code works on each prompt: the main conversation's reasoning effort (low to xhigh, raised to max mid-turn when tool calls keep failing), each subagent's model, whether to split the work across subagents, and the one skill the prompt needs. Reads the prompt with recent context, records every decision, and suggests its own tuning. Backends: OpenRouter, TypeSafe's API, the Vercel AI Gateway, or Claude Code's built-in classifier. Built on claude-code-templates' jev-model-router and jev-skill-suggestion.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for TypeSafe's own API; preferred over the Gateway, since only it reports a calibrated confidence

gatewayApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway API key
gatewayApiKey.description: Key for the AI Gateway, used when neither a TypeSafe nor an OpenRouter key is set; it reports no calibrated confidence

openrouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouterApiKey.description: Key for OpenRouter, which hosts Jev (~typesafe/jev-latest) on its System One route and reports a calibrated confidence like TypeSafe's own API

provider.title: Backend
provider.description: Which backend to use; "auto" picks TypeSafe when its key is set, then OpenRouter, then the Gateway, then the built-in classifier

typesafeBaseUrl.title: TypeSafe base URL
typesafeBaseUrl.description: Base URL of TypeSafe's own API; empty uses https://api.typesafe.ai

typesafeModel.title: TypeSafe model
typesafeModel.description: Decision model on TypeSafe's own API; empty uses jev-latest

gatewayBaseUrl.title: AI Gateway base URL
gatewayBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the AI Gateway; empty uses https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v4/ai

gatewayModel.title: AI Gateway model
gatewayModel.description: Decision model on the AI Gateway; empty uses typesafe-ai/jev

openrouterBaseUrl.title: OpenRouter base URL
openrouterBaseUrl.description: Base URL of OpenRouter's API; empty uses https://openrouter.ai/api (requests go to /v1/systemone)

openrouterModel.title: OpenRouter model
openrouterModel.description: Jev model on OpenRouter; empty uses ~typesafe/jev-latest (pin e.g. typesafe/jev-1.13)

fastModel.title: Fast tier
fastModel.description: Model alias or id for mechanical, local tasks

balancedModel.title: Balanced tier
balancedModel.description: Model alias or id for ordinary engineering work

deepModel.title: Deep tier
deepModel.description: Model alias or id for hard or high-stakes work

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend more
minUpgradeConfidence.description: How sure the decision must be to raise the model or the effort; being wrong here costs money, so the bar is low

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend less
minDowngradeConfidence.description: How sure it must be to lower the model or the effort; being wrong here means a task gets too little, so the bar is high

effortCloseMargin.title: Close-call margin
effortCloseMargin.description: When Jev's two most likely effort levels are within this probability of each other, the higher one is used (under-thinking costs more than over-thinking); 0 turns the lean off

routeSubagentModel.title: Route subagent models
routeSubagentModel.description: Pick the model of each subagent at agent.spawn (the Agent tool takes no effort)

routeMainEffort.title: Route the main loop's effort
routeMainEffort.description: Raise or lower the reasoning effort of the main conversation

routeMainModel.title: Route the main loop's model
routeMainModel.description: Change the model of the main conversation; off by default because switching models mid-session invalidates the prompt cache

maxEffort.title: Starting effort ceiling
maxEffort.description: The highest reasoning level a turn may start at; higher levels are reached only by the mid-turn raise. An effort you set above it by hand is left alone

maxRaisedEffort.title: Raised effort ceiling
maxRaisedEffort.description: The highest reasoning level a struggling turn may be raised to (see escalateAfterErrors)

escalateAfterErrors.title: Raise effort after failures
escalateAfterErrors.description: Tool calls that must fail in a row within a turn before its effort goes up (at least one rung, once per turn); 0 turns this off

contextMessages.title: Recent messages sent
contextMessages.description: How many messages before the prompt the decision model reads (text and tool names only, never tool input or output); 0 sends none

contextChars.title: Recent context budget
contextChars.description: The most characters those messages may take together; the newest are kept

suggestStrategy.title: Advise how to carry out the task
suggestStrategy.description: Ask the decision model whether a request is best done directly, by one subagent, by parallel subagents or as a small graph of subagents, and attach that advice to the prompt when it is confident

minStrategyConfidence.title: Strategy confidence
minStrategyConfidence.description: How sure the answer must be before delegate or parallel advice is attached

minGraphConfidence.title: Graph confidence
minGraphConfidence.description: The higher bar for graph advice, the costliest way to work; it also needs the task read as deep

graphSkill.title: Graph skill
graphSkill.description: A skill the graph advice may name for a heavier workflow (e.g. agentic-graph-skill); empty keeps the advice to plain subagent waves

timeoutMs.title: Latency budget (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long each module waits for a decision before letting the prompt or request through unchanged

display.title: Where jev-pilot talks
display.description: "pet": Claude the pilot above the prompt, showing what Claude is doing, with a speech bubble saying each decision (nothing in the conversation); "transcript": one line per turn in the conversation; "both"; or "off". /jev pet off hides the pet, and is remembered

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Master switch for jev-pilot's own messages: errors always, plus the transcript lines when display is transcript or both

verboseLog.title: Verbose log
verboseLog.description: Write every step instead: both modules' decisions, the skill ranking and rerank, the withheld listing, and why a turn was left alone

recordDecisions.title: Record decisions
recordDecisions.description: Keep each main-conversation turn's decision and outcome (effort, raises, failures, tokens; never prompt text) in the plugin's store, for /jev-pilot:report and its suggested tuning

inject.title: How the chosen skill reaches the model
inject.description: "content" attaches the skill's SKILL.md to the prompt, so it loads even when the engine lists it as user-invocable-only or off; "suggest" only names it and the model loads it with the Skill tool

hideListing.title: Hide the skill listing
hideListing.description: Leave the engine's skill listing out of the main conversation's context; off keeps the listing and only adds the suggestion

suggestSkills.title: Pick skills
suggestSkills.description: Pick the one skill each prompt needs and keep the skill listing out of context; off leaves skills exactly as Claude Code handles them (/jev skills on|off switches it live)

rerank.title: Re-read the shortlist
rerank.description: Send a second request that re-reads the top skills with their full description and SKILL.md opening, and can reject them all; off suggests the top of the ranking alone

shortlist.title: Shortlist size
shortlist.description: How many of the ranking the second request re-reads

gateThreshold.title: Needs-a-skill threshold
gateThreshold.description: Mean of the three request nouls (acts on the user's system, would follow a documented procedure, prose does not suffice) under which nothing is suggested

fitsThreshold.title: Fits threshold
fitsThreshold.description: A shortlist whose best per-skill "does this fit" noul is under this is dropped entirely

excerptChars.title: SKILL.md excerpt
excerptChars.description: How many characters of each shortlisted skill's body the second request reads

alwaysListed.title: Always listed
alwaysListed.description: Comma-separated skill names that stay in the listing whatever the prompt (the model can still see and call them)

neverSuggested.title: Never suggested
neverSuggested.description: Comma-separated skill names the decision model is never offered; they stay reachable by typing /name
